real_problem_evidence.headline_evidence: 15 datasets, 47590 operations, 1611 stacks in the supplemental smoke set.
real_problem_evidence.limitations: Does not prove full-scale conversion of every public benchmark or image/video archive.
real_problem_evidence.novelty_value: The paper artifact under test is a two-object profiler model, not another fixed agent trace viewer.
real_problem_evidence.profiler_mechanism: Normalize every source row into operations, then use operation stacks as query-time projections.
real_problem_evidence.public_oracle: 15 public labeled trajectory sources with dataset/session/task/action/quality fields.
real_problem_evidence.real_problem: Agent traces mix prompts, tools, GUI actions, API calls, safety labels, and quality labels; prompt/session/span object models split these into incompatible pipelines.

real_problem_evidence.headline_evidence: R286 folds the same 13265 operations from 9 dataset stacks to 57 phase, 455 action, and 3757 fixed-session stacks; R293 stack override reduces AgentNet stacks by 86.349%.
real_problem_evidence.limitations: Does not identify one universal best stack for every task.
real_problem_evidence.novelty_value: Recursive folding is a query over operation fields rather than a hard-coded prompt/session hierarchy.
real_problem_evidence.profiler_mechanism: Fold the same operations at different stack depths by changing only the stack specification.
real_problem_evidence.public_oracle: R286 depth sweep and R293 AgentNet profile-spec override.
real_problem_evidence.real_problem: The useful boundary depends on the debugging question; a fixed session/prompt stack either hides phase structure or fragments aggregation.

real_problem_evidence.headline_evidence: R282 mapping reduces held-out unique stacks by 26.408% and improves compression by 35.889%; R285 has 0 negative folds; R297 supervised boundary F1 is 0.7735.
real_problem_evidence.limitations: Does not support unsupervised or cross-family general boundary detection.
real_problem_evidence.novelty_value: Mapping/tagging and boundary backends are one extension point: derive fields, never introduce a third profiler object.
real_problem_evidence.profiler_mechanism: Run deterministic or learned field derivation before stack construction, then fold ordinary operation fields.
real_problem_evidence.public_oracle: R282 held-out mappings, R285 leave-dataset-out mappings, and R297 held-out OSWorld-Human boundary labels.
real_problem_evidence.real_problem: Raw dataset labels and action names are inconsistent; without field derivation, stacks are either too shallow or too fragmented.

real_problem_evidence.headline_evidence: Conservative human-group projection reaches boundary F1 0.6268 at precision 1.0; R297 learned backend improves over phase/action/target baselines and folds 1132 held-out operations into 74 stacks.
real_problem_evidence.limitations: R290 conservative recall is limited; R297 is supervised and OSWorld-only.
real_problem_evidence.novelty_value: The same action sequence supports action-depth, human-group-depth, and learned-boundary-depth views.
real_problem_evidence.profiler_mechanism: Carry human-group labels and learned-group fields as stackable operation fields.
real_problem_evidence.public_oracle: OSWorld-Human single-action and grouped-action human trajectories.
real_problem_evidence.real_problem: Desktop agents often need subtask-level inspection below a task but above a raw click/key action.

real_problem_evidence.headline_evidence: AgentRewardBench repeat-signal/looping V-measure is 0.3777 versus 0.0105 for step-error; SATraj has 622 unsafe operations; AgentNet step_correct and step_redundant fields have 16741 and 16741 covered operations.
real_problem_evidence.limitations: Does not prove developer productivity or automatic quality prediction.
real_problem_evidence.novelty_value: The profiler exposes non-flamegraph quality and safety views without creating separate failure or safety profilers.
real_problem_evidence.profiler_mechanism: Represent expert labels, safety labels, and sequence-derived repetition signals as operation fields, then score and visualize them with stack reports.
real_problem_evidence.public_oracle: AgentRewardBench expert looping labels, SATraj-OS safety labels, and AgentNet step correctness/redundancy labels.
real_problem_evidence.real_problem: Agent debugging requires failure, safety, looping, and step-quality diagnostics, not only hot paths.

real_problem_evidence.headline_evidence: R294 trace import and operation import folded outputs are identical; R296 indexes 11 visualization/evidence entries and 4 reviewer questions.
real_problem_evidence.limitations: Reviewer packets are synthesis artifacts, not new empirical evidence.
real_problem_evidence.novelty_value: The contribution includes an auditable research workflow around configurable profiler queries, not just a rendered flamegraph.
real_problem_evidence.profiler_mechanism: Use tracked profile specs, trace exchange, claim synthesis, and reviewer evidence packets as reproducibility surfaces.
real_problem_evidence.public_oracle: R293 profile spec, R294 trace exchange, R295 claim synthesis, and R296 reviewer packet.
real_problem_evidence.real_problem: Paper claims drift when results are scattered across shell commands, folded files, and one-off visualizations.
